lastCompletedStory.title: Discriminated GhPollFn result and edge-triggered poll-error emit in stepMergeWatch

nextStoryContext: Both PRD stories (US-001, US-002) now pass. GhPollFn (src/release/merge-watch.ts) returns a discriminated GhPollResult (ok:true carrying PrStatus, ok:false carrying the gh stderr) instead of PrStatus | null. stepMergeWatch increments MergeWatchState.consecutiveNullPolls on each error result, resets it to 0 on any successful poll, and emits exactly one 'merge-watch-poll-error' event + one notifyOrchestrator narration when the counter crosses POLL_ERROR_THRESHOLD (3, exported constant). The error branch was extracted into a named helper (handlePollError) to stay under the biome complexity/line-count gates, mirroring the existing handleMergedStatus/handleBehindStatus/handleBlockedStatus pattern in the same file. The production ghPollFn wrapper in src/commands/sidecar.ts now delegates JSON-parse/exit-code handling to a new exported-from-module-scope helper parseGhPollResult(result: SpawnSyncReturns<string>) for the same complexity reason; a gh non-zero exit or malformed-JSON response surfaces spawnSync's stderr (or a synthesized message when stderr is empty) into the error result. A poll error is always a silent retry: it never changes the watch's terminal outcome (proven by tests: polling continues past N to the existing maxPolls timeout, and a fail-then-recover sequence reaches MERGED normally without ever emitting merge-watch-stalled). src/commands/sidecar.ts grew past its file-size-budget ceiling (2163->2187 lines, split('\n').length convention = wc -l + 1); the ceiling was raised with a tracker ref staged in the same commit per the ratchet-gate pattern. If a future story picks up this PRD, note that prd.json now has zero passes:false stories, so the next cam-next invocation should read PRD_COMPLETE and hand off to /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed gh exits 1 on general/API failure (also 4 on auth failure), matching the existing (result.status ?? 1) !== 0 non-zero-exit check reused from the pre-US-001 ghPollFn. gh_pr_view docs confirm --json produces JSON on success; the stderr-diagnostics-location convention (used to surface the error message) was not explicitly documented by either page but matches the standard CLI convention already relied on elsewhere in this codebase (postMergeSpawnFn, updateBranchFn) for capturing spawnSync stderr from other gh subcommands.
